title: Backyard Barrels
summary:
refining is filling the gap in South America
Sometimes things just work out. Until 2006, the United States was a significant (and growing) net importer of refined products. imports of petroleum products peaked at the end of 2005 at 4.5 million barrels per day (b/d).
